Create a CacheConnection object

Source: R/CacheConnection-class.R
init_CacheConnection.Rd

init_CacheConnection initializes a CacheConnection either from a provided .rds file path or directly from a cd_data object. Only one of the arguments should be non-NULL.

Usage

init_CacheConnection(
  rds_path = NULL,
  countdown_data = NULL,
  data_path = NULL,
  wizard_parts = NULL,
  indicator_group = c("auto", "rmncah", "vaccine", "custom"),
  read_only = FALSE
)

Arguments

rds_path

Optional character. Path to an RDS file to load the cache from.

countdown_data

Optional cd_data object to initialize in-memory cache.

data_path

Optional character. Path to the original source file (e.g. the .xlsx countdown_data was parsed from). The cache is kept beside it, as a .rds file with the same name.

wizard_parts

Optional load_excel_parts() result: the sheets of an upload that the Load Data wizard has read but not yet merged. Use it instead of rds_path or countdown_data.

indicator_group

Character. Specifies the indicator group to use (auto, rmncah, vaccine, custom).

read_only

Logical. TRUE never writes the cache back to its .rds: for reading a dataset another process (the app) owns, e.g. the AI's copy.

Value

An instance of the CacheConnection class.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core")
data <- load_data(path)
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah

# in memory: no file is written
cache <- init_CacheConnection(countdown_data = data)
cache$country
#> [1] "Kenya"
cache$data_years
#> [1] 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the dataset an app saved, opened without ever writing to it
cache <- init_CacheConnection(rds_path = "kenya_rmncah.rds", read_only = TRUE)
} # }
